name: Jinrui Daihyou ni Erabareta Watashi ga Uchuujin kara Chikyuu o Mamoru Kantan na Oshigoto
original_name: 人類代表に選ばれた私が宇宙人から地球を守る簡単なお仕事
source:
"Convince me and save the Earth. It’s a simple task, isn’t it?"

Nova, an alien who suddenly appeared to invade Earth, has randomly chosen you to represent humanity so he can learn about the wonders of Earth.
translation:
“说服我，拯救地球吧。这可是件很简单的工作吧？”

突然现身企图侵略地球的外星人诺瓦，随手抽中了你担任全人类的代表，好让他借机领略地球的种种美妙之处。
